question: Should OpenClaw continue this Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The issue spans bundled UI, plugin SDK, persistent state, browser sandboxing, command/data binding, install surfaces, and distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor staged dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

options.title: Narrow to generic extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, galleries, and app bundles to prove themselves through external packages or ClawHub first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Leave the linked implementation stack unmerged and close or defer the roadmap if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest maintainer-side product signal is the recently merged Logbook plugin-tab precedent that this roadmap builds on.
